## What's Changed
### Other Changes
* Integrate Artemis main-menu performance fixes by @KYoiRyi in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/68
* fix(ios): support KAG virtual keyboard input by @MadCcc in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/76
* fix(render): stabilize alpha composition and KAG UI compatibility by @akitaSummer in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/77
* Fix E-mote memory retention and expand runtime diagnostics by @akitaSummer in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/80
* fix: prevent top-aligned layer text clipping by @akitaSummer in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/85
* fix: support 乱れ雪月華 startup plugins by @akitaSummer in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/87
* fix(render): restore Senren Banka UI rendering by @MadCcc in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/86
* feat: integrate Artemis runtime provider by @JasmineLCY in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/59
* feat(ui): polish the adaptive application shell by @KYoiRyi in https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/pull/88


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/AetherKiri/AetherKiri/compare/0.1.0-alpha.3...0.2.0
